assets.name: Primary logo — horizontal, on dark
assets.description: Mark and wordmark side by side, near-white on the navy field. The default lockup; use wherever the space is wider than it is tall. Wordmark is live Sora text, not paths.

assets.name: Primary logo — horizontal, on light
assets.description: The horizontal lockup with navy ink, for white or pale surfaces.

assets.name: Logo — stacked, on dark
assets.description: Mark above wordmark, for square-ish space: splash screens, centred cards, sponsor slots.

assets.name: Logo — stacked, on light
assets.description: The stacked lockup with navy ink, for white or pale surfaces.

assets.name: Mark, on dark
assets.description: The eight-node mark alone, near-white nodes with the cyan core. Where the brand is already established — avatars, loading states.

assets.name: Mark, on light
assets.description: The mark with navy nodes, for white or pale surfaces.

assets.name: Mark, one colour, on dark
assets.description: Single-colour reproduction in near-white. For engraving, stamps, or anywhere the cyan cannot follow.

assets.name: Mark, one colour, on light
assets.description: Single-colour reproduction in navy, for light surfaces.

assets.name: App icon
assets.description: Rounded-square tile with the full mark. Home screens and app stores; 1024px master.

assets.name: Favicon
assets.description: Simplified tile: spokes dropped, cardinal nodes removed, core enlarged. Legible at 16px, where the full mark turns to mush.

assets.name: Primary logo — horizontal, on dark (PNG)
assets.description: 1600x373 raster of the horizontal lockup on navy, with Sora baked in. For Slack, email, and anywhere SVG is not accepted.
